raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

The direct UMBP linker (`--enable-unified-cache-external-linker`, DRAM KV offload) only builds device pool groups for DeepSeek-V4 and DSA. A MiniMax-M3 prefill with the linker fails at startup:

```
ValueError: The selected hybrid pool strategy does not support the direct external linker: _MiniMaxSparseStrategy.
```

So M3 cannot run PD prefill with UMBP KV offload, the setup AMD's agentic PD recipes use for DeepSeek-V4.

Plan:
1. This PR: linker pool group for the released M3 layout (main KV + K-only lightning-indexer cache).
2. Follow-up if needed: HiSparse, index-V sparse layers and MTP drafts (rejected for now).

## Modifications

- `linker_pool_assembler.py`: `_build_minimax_sparse_device_pool_group`.
  - `KV` = main-pool K and V of every layer.
  - `INDEXER` = K-only index cache of the sparse layers, keyed by global layer id and sharing KV's page ids (the same pairing PD transfer uses via `StateType.MINIMAX_INDEX_K`).
  - `rank_replicated=False`, since GQA KV heads are sharded across TP ranks.
  - Rows follow `kv_cache_layout`: token rows for `nhd`, page rows for `hnd` / `vectorized_5d`.
- `hybrid_pool_assembler.py`: `_MiniMaxSparseStrategy.build_direct_linker_pool_group`.
- HiSparse, index-V layers, scaled KV and MTP drafts raise instead of offloading partial state.
- Unit test in `test_linker_pool_assembler.py`; it fails on `main` with the error above.

## Accuracy Tests

Setup: MiniMax-M3-MXFP8 on one MI355X node, mori PD with TP4 prefill + TP4 decode. The prefill runs the linker against a UMBP standalone server with a 200 GB DRAM tier.

- **Load-back:** ~8K-token retrieval prompt. A = cold; C = resend (GPU radix hit); then `/flush_cache`; B = resend, with 7,936 tokens restored from UMBP. **B == C exactly**, and both give the correct `84903, 18242, 00198`.
- **Chat probe through the PD router:** GSM8K-style question answered `#### 72`, `finish_reason=stop`.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Offload volume is 22,656 B/token/rank: 15,360 B of fp8 main KV plus 7,296 B of index-K for the 57 sparse layers. Medians; on = PD + linker, off = PD only:

| input | TTFT on / off (ms) | PD transfer tail on / off (ms) | offload write (ms) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 8K | 282 / 279 | 7.4 / 6.6 | 31 |
| 32K | 1,061 / 1,057 | 14.2 / 12.8 | 127 |
| 128K | 4,529 / 4,522 | 33.0 / 30.0 | 537 |
| 512K | 23,667 / 23,577 | 105.8 / 100.1 | 2,197 |

- The offload starts when the last chunk is queued for PD transfer and runs at ~5-6 GB/s per rank.
- Sequential TTFT cost is <= 0.4%; 8 x 32K concurrent bursts are +5% TTFT.

Known issue on the UMBP side, not introduced here: occasional first-use puts of 3-17 s, at warmup or the first burst, delay the next prefill. On the test node they correlated with host direct reclaim.

Tested on an image built from `main` at 41cbe65de0; the touched code is unchanged on current `main`. The unit test was run on this branch.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (n/a)
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

@@ -442,6 +442,61 @@ def _build_dsa_device_pool_group(
     return DevicePoolGroup(entries, num_layers, page_size, rank_replicated=True)
 
 
+def _build_minimax_sparse_device_pool_group(
+    kvcache: Any,
+    page_size: int,
+    mtp_draft_device_pools: tuple[Any, ...] = (),
+) -> DevicePoolGroup:
+    if kvcache.page_size != page_size:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "MiniMax sparse KV page size must match the tree page size: "
+            f"{kvcache.page_size} != {page_size}."
+        )
+    if mtp_draft_device_pools:
+        raise ValueError("MiniMax sparse direct linker does not support MTP drafts.")
+    # HiSparse and index-V layers keep state outside main_pool / index_k_pool.
+    if kvcache.dense_pool is not None or kvcache.index_kv_pool is not None:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "MiniMax sparse direct linker supports only K-only sparse layers "
+            "without HiSparse."
+        )
+    main = kvcache.main_pool
+    if main.is_quantized_kv_cache:
+        raise ValueError("MiniMax sparse direct linker does not support scaled KV.")
+
+    num_layers = kvcache.layer_num
+    entries = [
+        DevicePoolEntry(
+            name=PoolName.KV,
+            indices_from_pool=PoolName.KV,
+            device_pool=kvcache,
+            components=[main.k_buffer, main.v_buffer],
+            layer_mapping={layer: layer for layer in range(num_layers)},
+            page_size=page_size,
+            rows_are_pages=main.kv_cache_layout != "nhd",
+        )
+    ]
+    index_pool = kvcache.index_k_pool
+    if index_pool is not None:
+        # Index-K rows share the main KV slot ids; buffers are per sparse layer.
+        entries.append(
+            DevicePoolEntry(
+                name=PoolName.INDEXER,
+                indices_from_pool=PoolName.KV,
+                device_pool=kvcache,
+                components=[index_pool.k_buffer],
+                layer_mapping={
+                    layer - kvcache.start_layer: index
+                    for layer, index in kvcache.index_k_layer_id_mapping.items()
+                },
+                page_size=page_size,
+                rows_are_pages=False,
+            )
+        )
+    # GQA KV heads are sharded across TP ranks, so each rank stores its own objects.
+    return DevicePoolGroup(entries, num_layers, page_size, rank_replicated=False)
+
+
 def resolve_hybrid_device_pool_group(
     *,
     kvcache: Any,

@@ -472,6 +472,87 @@ def dsa_pool(kv_width, index_width):
         self.assertEqual(sizes, [[11, 23]])
         self.assertEqual(offsets, [[7, 35]])
 
+    def test_minimax_sparse_ships_main_kv_and_index_k(self):
+        """Each page object must carry K, V and the sparse layers' index-K;
+        dense layers have no index-K, and unsupported layouts must fail loudly."""
+        from sglang.srt.mem_cache.memory_pool import MiniMaxSparseKVPool
+
+        def minimax_pool():
+            kvcache = MiniMaxSparseKVPool.__new__(MiniMaxSparseKVPool)
+            kvcache.page_size = 2
+            kvcache.layer_num = 3
+            kvcache.start_layer = 0
+            kvcache.main_pool = SimpleNamespace(
+                is_quantized_kv_cache=False,
+                kv_cache_layout="nhd",
+                k_buffer=[torch.zeros((8, w), dtype=torch.uint8) for w in (3, 5, 7)],
+                v_buffer=[torch.zeros((8, w), dtype=torch.uint8) for w in (11, 13, 17)],
+            )
+            # Layer 0 is dense; layers 1 and 2 are K-only sparse layers.
+            kvcache.index_k_pool = SimpleNamespace(
+                k_buffer=[torch.zeros((8, w), dtype=torch.uint8) for w in (19, 23)]
+            )
+            kvcache.index_k_layer_id_mapping = {1: 0, 2: 1}
+            kvcache.dense_pool = None
+            kvcache.index_kv_pool = None
+            return kvcache
+
+        def resolve(kvcache, draft_pools=()):
+            return resolve_hybrid_device_pool_group(
+                kvcache=kvcache,
+                page_size=2,
+                params=SimpleNamespace(mtp_draft_device_pools=draft_pools),
+                components={ComponentType.FULL},
+            )
+
+        kvcache = minimax_pool()
+        group = resolve(kvcache)
+
+        self.assertEqual(group.num_layers, 3)
+        self.assertFalse(group.rank_replicated)
+        self.assertEqual(
+            group.sources, {PoolName.KV: PoolName.KV, PoolName.INDEXER: PoolName.KV}
+        )
+        kv = group.entry_map[PoolName.KV]
+        locations = kv.prepare_locations(torch.tensor([2, 3]))
+        pointers, sizes, offsets = kv.get_prepared_layer_range_meta(locations, 1)
+        main = kvcache.main_pool
+        self.assertEqual(
+            pointers, [[main.k_buffer[1][2].data_ptr(), main.v_buffer[1][2].data_ptr()]]
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(sizes, [[10, 26]])
+        self.assertEqual(offsets, [[6, 52]])
+
+        indexer = group.entry_map[PoolName.INDEXER]
+        self.assertIsNone(indexer.get_prepared_layer_range_meta(locations, 0))
+        pointers, sizes, offsets = indexer.get_prepared_layer_range_meta(locations, 2)
+        self.assertEqual(pointers, [[kvcache.index_k_pool.k_buffer[1][2].data_ptr()]])
+        self.assertEqual(sizes, [[46]])
+        self.assertEqual(offsets, [[38]])
+
+        resolved = group.resolve_transfers(
+            [
+                PoolTransfer(
+                    name=PoolName.KV,
+                    keys=["page-1"],
+                    device_indices=torch.tensor([2, 3]),
+                )
+            ]
+        )
+        self.assertEqual({t.name for t in resolved}, {PoolName.KV, PoolName.INDEXER})
+
+        for field, value in (
+            ("index_kv_pool", object()),
+            ("dense_pool", object()),
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(unsupported=field):
+                kvcache = minimax_pool()
+                setattr(kvcache, field, value)
+                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "only K-only sparse layers"):
+                    resolve(kvcache)
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "does not support MTP drafts"):
+            resolve(minimax_pool(), draft_pools=(object(),))
+
     def test_linker_requires_packed_draft(self):
         """Do not accept draft state that the linker would omit from storage."""
